gaps: No guaranteed wheelchair-accessible route or personal suitability assessment.
No typed measured dimensions or individual vote observation dates on the verified public web surface.
Only bounded keyword/page discovery and selected saved spots; no worldwide bulk sync.
Contributor/profile, photo, comment, narrative and TrackLog data excluded.

narrative.headline: Find and compare recorded accessibility facts with gaps and conflicting reports visible.
narrative.value_prop: Search public WheeLog spots, inspect category-specific equipment questions, and compare a bounded shortlist. Save normalized public-place evidence for offline lookup, recheck triage, straight-line proximity and exact observation changes.
narrative.auth_narrative: The supported public spot surface works anonymously over ordinary HTTPS. No account, API key, cookies or resident browser is needed.

quickstart.comment: Check the CLI setup without making source requests.
Choose an exact category and understand its question-ID range.

quickstart.command: wheelog-pp-cli spots search 成田空港 --category toilet --limit 3 --agent
quickstart.comment: Find original source spot IDs for a public facility keyword.
Read aggregate equipment reports for a selected source spot.

troubleshoots.fix: Use the original place name or a broader source keyword; an empty bounded result is not proof of no accessible facilities.

troubleshoots.symptom: A question has zero or conflicting reports
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect the retained positive/negative counts and use the canonical source page for further checking.
Use --data-source local for saved evidence or retry the bounded source request later.

narrative.when_to_use: Use WheeLog for public crowdsourced wheelchair-accessibility spot evidence, exact source question comparisons and a small offline public-facility shortlist. Japan is the initial travel use case; source keywords can cover other countries. Preserve report counts, unknowns and source record dates when describing results.
anti_triggers: Guaranteed accessible routes or personal wheelchair suitability.
Measured dimensions, live opening conditions or per-report observation dates not supplied by the public source.
Contributor profiles, personal TrackLogs, messages, posts, bookings or account changes.
